description: Capability for the main window. remote.urls must cover whatever origin tauri.conf.json's window actually loads, or the webview gets zero Tauri permissions (including store:default — the offline queue's Tauri Store adapter would silently stop working). scripts/check-production-config.mjs verifies this stays true before every production build. The second entry below is a placeholder (RFC 2606 .invalid, never resolves) until a real production domain is chosen — update it, alongside tauri.conf.json's PRODUCTION_APP_URL equivalent, at that point; do not remove the localhost entry, it's still needed for local dev.
